timeMeaning: One hour of virtual time at 20× acceleration, not a one-hour wall-clock soak.
limitations: Abstract kinematics; no validated flight or physical sensor model.
See separate populated-scene browser measurements for graphics performance.

metrics.name: command_completed
metrics.definition: Commands with recorded final state COMPLETED.

metrics.name: command_terminal
metrics.definition: Commands ending COMPLETED, REJECTED, FAILED, TIMED_OUT or CANCELLED.

metrics.name: duplicate_samples
metrics.definition: Repeated exact sample IDs in accepted sealed batches; rejected gateway retries are not new accepted events.

metrics.name: fragmented_actors
metrics.definition: Observed actors associated with more than one recorded track.

metrics.name: late_observations
metrics.definition: Published observations received by the COP more than 1000 virtual ms after configured delivery.

metrics.name: mean_command_ack
metrics.definition: Mean first runtime acknowledgment elapsed time minus command issue time; no-ACK commands excluded.

metrics.name: mean_command_completion
metrics.definition: Mean runtime completion elapsed time minus command issue time for completed commands.

metrics.name: mean_horizontal_error
metrics.definition: Mean local horizontal error only where a sealed active snapshot exists at the exact sample millisecond.

metrics.name: mean_observation_delay
metrics.definition: Mean COP publication virtual time minus original sample time.

metrics.name: merged_tracks
metrics.definition: Recorded tracks containing observations from more than one sealed actor.

metrics.name: missed_observations
metrics.definition: Expected active actor/sensor slots due by final virtual time without a recorded published observation; includes configured scheduled misses.

metrics.name: scenario_completed
metrics.definition: Run reached declared duration with runtime status COMPLETED.

metrics.name: scheduled_misses
metrics.definition: Frozen dropEvery slots among expected slots.

measurementConditions: Virtual-hour test, requested scale 20; COP samples cover the resumed monitor interval. Concurrent browser regressions and image build. Not a one-hour wall-clock soak.
